decisions.reason: As a recently launched carpet close to the existing range and given its own product page, management is likely to continue it because some public commitment and development effort have already been made and there is no clear evidence yet of lasting failure.

This more crafted hand-knotted wool silk carpet likely embodies higher sunk design and sourcing effort, so under escalation of commitment management would be inclined to keep it on the market absent clear negative results.

Although another low-pile decorative carpet may be somewhat replaceable within a broad assortment, its recent launch and visible presentation still make management more likely to persist than to admit an early mistake.
A corner bench builds directly on the firm's core furniture offer, and with a growing industry and no reported problems management would likely justify keeping it in the line for longer.
This low-pile carpet is near the established business and was publicly introduced, so the firm is likely to retain it at least another year unless disappointing performance becomes unmistakable.

A swivel shell chair fits the firm's core competence in seating and flexible interiors, and the combination of strategic fit, recent investment and public launch makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.
